subject: Pricing inquiry + competitive match for Hosted API (per-token & commit tiers)
messages:
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@tidalapps.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: TidalApps Procurement <procurement@tidalapps.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing and competitive match inquiry — Hosted API (per-token)

Hi Evelyn,

Quick intro — I manage platform integrations at TidalApps. We're evaluating hosted inference options for a new generative feature (customer messages + summarization). Two quick asks: can Redwood provide per-token hosted pricing and commit-tier examples we can compare against OpenAI and Anthropic, and do you have a policy for price matching / displacement if we move off another provider?

Expected baseline: ~200M tokens/month for Q2 with spikes to 400M. Primary questions: effective per-token cost at 200M and 400M, what a 12-month commit looks like, and any onboarding credits or migration support.

Also attaching our standard procurement questionnaire (I can send separately to procurement if needed).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

— Samantha
Samantha Nguyen
Platform Product Manager, TidalApps
Phone: +1-415-555-0198
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@tidalapps.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing and competitive match inquiry — Hosted API (per-token)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the context and the volume estimates. Looping in Ben Carter (pricing & deals) so we can model a few commit scenarios.

High level: Redwood's hosted per-token pricing is usage-based with optional 12/24-month commit tiers that materially lower effective cost. We also offer displacement credits for customers coming off other providers when there's a contract commitment and a defined migration plan. I'll need a quick usage breakdown by model (inference sizes), percent input vs output tokens, and tolerance for latency to size the right offering.

If you want a blunt comparator now, we usually model 3 buckets:
- Light gen (chat/short responses): model_x_small — baseline per-token higher but latency optimized
- Standard gen: model_x_standard — best cost/quality for most workloads
- Longform/embedding heavy: model_x_long — larger context / higher compute

If you can share the split (or let us run a short trace run) we can return concrete per-token numbers and a draft term sheet by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@tidalapps.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-23T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pricing and competitive match inquiry — Hosted API (per-token)

Hi Samantha — following up with concrete numbers based on the 200M / 400M token baselines you shared. I've attached a spreadsheet (tidalapps_pricing_comparison_v1.xlsx) with itemized math and a short comparison to public OpenAI/Anthropic endpoint pricing. Notes first:

Summary (monthly effective rates, USD per 1k tokens):
- No commit (on-demand): $0.023 per 1k tokens (standard gen model_x_standard)
- 12-month commit (200M tokens/month): $0.015 per 1k tokens
- 12-month commit (400M tokens/month): $0.012 per 1k tokens
- 24-month commit (flex): $0.010 per 1k tokens + 5% annual consumption credit

Competitive match policy (proposal):
- We can offer a one-time displacement match for a qualified competitor price (OpenAI/Anthropic/cloud endpoint public list price) for the first 6 months if TidalApps signs a minimum 12-month contract at the 200M token/month level or higher. The match applies to the model family equivalent and excludes ephemeral promotional rates or reseller-only discounts.

Migration & onboarding support:
- $50k one-time migration assistance credit applied against professional services or committed usage (applies with 12+ month commit)
- Dedicated SE hours for the first 90 days, and access to our Optimize playbook for batching/kv-caching to lower token consumption

Security & compliance highlights (we'll provide SOC2 attestations on request):
- SOC2 Type II available
- Optional Private (VPC) deployment for data residency

Attachments: tidalapps_pricing_comparison_v1.xlsx (pricing math), short term-sheet template included in the spreadsheet.

If these numbers look promising, I'll ask legal to draft a match term sheet and we can add the procurement contact for signature.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Deals, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@tidalapps.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-24T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing and competitive match inquiry — Hosted API (per-token)

Hi Ben / Evelyn — thanks for the quick math, that helps. A couple clarifications before we put Procurement on the thread: 

- Anthropic quoted us a promotional rate of $0.0009 per input token and $0.0012 per output token for their latest standard model for the first 6 months. Can Redwood match the equivalent effective blended rate for our mix under the 12-month commitment?
- TidalApps requires SOC2 evidence, data residency in AWS us-west-2, and an SLA with uptime targets + credits. Can you confirm those are standard in the offer?
- Procurement will want DocuSign-ready term sheet and the list of attachments for their package (invoices, certs).

If you can confirm matchability and send a draft DocuSign, we can route this internally and get back with a PO within 7 business days.

— Samantha
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@tidalapps.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-25T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing and competitive match inquiry — Hosted API (per-token)

Hi Samantha — looping in legal/pricing approval. Quick answer: we can approve a limited-time match to the Anthropic promotional effective blended rate for the first 6 months under the following conditions (final term sheet attached):

1) Commitment: 12-month contract with a minimum committed usage of 200M tokens/month (true-up quarterly).
2) Blended match: Redwood will match the stated promotional effective price on equivalent model class for months 1–6. Effective blended rate to be calculated from your token split; see attached redwood_match_term_sheet.pdf and the spreadsheet math.
3) Migration credits: $40k migration/service credit applied as a rebate on month 2 invoice.
4) Security & SLA: SOC2 Type II attestation will be provided; data residency via Hosted region us-west-2 is available; SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime with credits per standard SLA in the attached term sheet.
4) Exclusions: The match excludes opaque reseller discounts, partner-only bundles, or retroactive rebates.

Next steps: I've prepared a DocuSign link (related_links above) with a provisional term sheet and ribboned the procurement checklist. If TidalApps confirms acceptance of the commit and sign-by date in the DocuSign (15 business days), we will lock in the match and schedule onboarding.

Forwarding details from Ben and Evelyn below for context. Attachments: redwood_match_term_sheet.pdf, tidalapps_pricing_comparison_v1.xlsx.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
